summary: Removed corrupted duplicate code block in executor.py that caused syntax errors and leakage.

edits.hypothesis: Removing the syntactically invalid and duplicated failure-handling block restores correct control flow in the execution loop, preventing crashes and eliminating hard-coded tool-specific leakage.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: The existing code was broken (syntax error) and contained a second, redundant failure handler that hard-coded 'roi_crop'. Removing it is a structural fix required for the code to run at all.
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) The previous version of executor.py had a syntax error due to a malformed merge/duplicate block. This edit removes that block, allowing the agent to run without crashing. The remaining single failure injection (added in t=4/t=5) remains active to handle the uncritical acceptance mode. (preservative) Successful cases like q000003 are unaffected as they do not trigger tool failures. (transfer) Generalizes by ensuring the harness code is valid and free of task-specific hard-coding in the control flow.
edits.regression_risk: None. The removed code was dead/broken and duplicated logic already present in the valid block above it.
edits.mechanism: Removing the syntactically invalid and duplicated failure-handling block restores correct control flow in the execution loop, preventing crashes and eliminating hard-coded tool-specific leakage.
